technical.summary: Bullish trend structure with strong moving average alignment and volume confirmation, but momentum indicators show divergence (negative MACD, elevated RSI) suggesting caution on entry timing despite ADX confirmation.

fundamental.summary: AES shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 63 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (29/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent recent congressional activity and news data limit conviction; neutral AAII sentiment suggests mixed positioning.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (305.4) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals, NFP event imminent, and utilities face credit spread widening in risk-off environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with 15x volume spike, ADX trending confirmation, and extreme market fear (29/100) creates contrarian entry opportunity in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), fundamental conviction is absent (no insider/institutional buying, high earnings risk within 63 days), and momentum divergence (negative MACD, RSI 68, StochRSI exhaustion) signals entry timing is premature despite technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows bullish trend alignment with volume confirmation, and extreme market fear presents contrarian opportunity. However, macro headwinds, absent fundamental conviction, and momentum divergence make entry timing premature.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve and VIX crisis signal recession risk; earnings announcement in 63 days creates binary event risk in utilities sector already facing credit spread widening.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show bullish signals, but fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose entry; debate decisively favors bear case.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 26 positions in Utilities sector and existing AES position; concentration risk and sector saturation argue against adding exposure.
